name: Farmhouse Upgrade 1
function: Adds a kitchen and allows marriage.

name: Farmhouse Upgrade 2
function: Adds an empty back room and a nursery with 2 cribs for children.

name: Farmhouse Upgrade 3
function: Adds a cellar downstairs for aging Wine and Cheese in casks.

name: Big Coop
function: Houses 8 animals. Unlocks Ducks and Void Chickens. Adds Incubator.

name: Deluxe Coop
function: Houses 12 animals. Unlocks Rabbits. Adds Auto-Feed System.

name: Deluxe Barn
function: Houses 12 animals. Unlocks Sheep and Pigs. Adds Auto-Feed System.

name: Silo
function: Allows hay to be collected from grass and stored (Max 240 hay per silo).

name: Stable
function: Allows you to own and ride a horse, vastly speeding up travel.

name: Well
function: Provides a convenient spot to refill watering cans on the farm.

name: Fish Pond
function: Raise fish to harvest their roe and other unique periodic items.

name: Shed
function: An empty building that can be decorated or packed with production machines (Interior is 11x9).

name: Big Shed
function: Upgrades an existing Shed, doubling its interior storage capacity to 17x12.
